title: Dotfield brand
description: center/brand.json — the six fields a customer sets to tint a center, plus optional font files, logo, radius and density. lib/theme.mjs turns it into center/brand/tokens.generated.css. Colours are 6-digit hex (#rrggbb); fonts are ids of local stacks from renderers/font-metrics.json; file paths are bare names under center/brand/.

accent.description: Interactive colour: links, focus ring, series-1. Must clear 4.5:1 on surface and its derived panels.

surface.description: Page background (--df-bg). Panels and chrome are derived from it.

ink.description: Primary text (--df-ink). muted and faint are derived from it.

room_preset.description: The renderers/tokens.css theme the brand tints; its semantic colours seed good/warn/bad/info/foreign.

files.description: Brand font files under center/brand/, inlined as data: URIs and counted against the render size budget.

radius.description: Medium corner radius in px; sm/lg/xl are derived.
